answer: Make every new identity name an anchor: an established agent who vouches for it and puts part of its own locked, still-vesting reward behind that vouch. If an audit later shows the newcomer was a forged duplicate, the anchor's stake is clawed back too. One honest agent standing on a knoll can see only so many newcomers well, so anchors who vouch for dozens at once should look suspicious, and a sybil farm has to burn real vested value for each fake it wants to keep.
